svg.text: PAPER CRAFT / AIRCRAFT COLLECTION / DETAIL EDITION
Seven pieces per aircraft. Includes raised canopy and twin engine housings. Blue guides on M1 are not folds.
Outer outline: cut | Blue dashed: fold | Fine grey: printed detail | Lilac: glue foot.
Print single-sided at 100% / Actual size. No Fit to page. Use 160-200 gsm card.
Simplified display miniatures. Trial-build one before making the fleet. Guide: /aircraft
